meta.title: Listed-peer market scoreboard — SET market value, valuation & returns (obj #2)
meta.label: MEASURED — Stock Exchange of Thailand (autonomous pull). Market cap/valuation as of the price date; ROE/net profit/assets from each peer's newest AUDITED FULL YEAR (SET quarter code Q9) — not simply the latest filing, which can be a partial-year interim. NOT an AutoX figure — AutoX is unlisted, so its 25% ROE TARGET is shown only as the reference line.
meta.source: Stock Exchange of Thailand · set.or.th in-browser JSON API (highlight-data + profile + company-highlight/financial-data)
meta.fin_basis: Each peer's headline ROE/profit/assets are its own newest quarter=="Q9" row (a closed, audited fiscal year). A row with a null totalRevenue or netProfit is treated as ABSENT and skipped, never shown as 0 or averaged in.
meta.roe_caveat: ROE is each peer's own SET-reported ratio for its newest audited fiscal year (SET quarter code Q9) — not an interim annualised off a partial year. Read net profit + market cap as the most directly comparable lines.
meta.holdco_caveat: TIDLOR HOLDINGS PCL listed 2025-05-15 as a new holding company following a restructure of the former Ngern Tid Lor group; its FY2024-and-earlier series is not continuous with the current listed entity, and its FY2024 row carries no consolidated P&L (totalRevenue/netProfit null) — FY2025 is its first full audited year as TIDLOR HOLDINGS.
meta.fs_type_caveat: fs_type marks the statement basis SET filed: "C" = consolidated, "U" = unconsolidated (company-only). HENG reports "U"; the other five report "C" — not a like-for-like statement basis, flagged rather than blended in.

headline: Listed rivals total ฿181bn of market value; Muangthai Capital is the largest at ฿68.9bn. Ngern Turbo leads share momentum this year (+36.1% YTD).
